en.title: Air Canada will not resume Toronto-Mumbai service as Air India steps in
en.summary: Air Canada will not resume its Toronto Pearson to Mumbai service next year as it restructures its Indian operations, with Air India taking over the route, leaving Delhi as the airline's only destination in India.
body: Air Canada will not resume its service from Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ) to Mumbai Airport (BOM) next year, as the airline restructures its Indian operations. The service historically operated with a stop at London Heathrow Airport (LHR), and data from Cirium shows it was flown with a mix of the airline's Boeing 787-8 and 787-9 aircraft, most recently in March 2026.

As Air Canada steps back from the route, Air India will serve it instead, with a stopover in Rome Fiumicino (FCO) Airport on the India to Canada leg and nonstop return flights expected. The change leaves Delhi Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) as Air Canada's only destination in India, served nonstop from Toronto year-round with seasonal flights added from Montreal.

zh.title: 加航明年不再恢復多倫多—孟買航線，印度航點僅剩德里
zh.summary: 加拿大航空明年將不再恢復多倫多皮爾遜機場至孟買機場的航線，改由印度航空接手營運，加航在印度的航點也將僅剩德里。
body: 加拿大航空明年將不再恢復多倫多皮爾遜機場（YYZ）至孟買機場的航線，該公司正在調整印度航線布局。這條航線過去經倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）中停，根據航空數據業者睿思譽的資料，航線曾以波音787-8與787-9混合執飛，最近一次營運是在2026年3月。
加航退出後，印度航空將接手這條航線，由印度飛往加拿大的一段將經羅馬菲烏米奇諾機場中停，回程預計直飛。調整完成後，德里英迪拉甘地國際機場將成為加航在印度唯一的航點，多倫多全年直飛德里，蒙特婁則有季節性航班。
